tei:div.tei:p: (hūm̐)༄༅// dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor mar brten pa'i gcod yul gyi gdams pa khyer bde mkha' 'gro'i snying gi thig bcud bzhugs so// ༈ /pha bla mar btud nas gnas yul dang*// dur khrod du spyod pa'i brtul zhugs kyis// nyams bde stong sbar zhing bdag 'dzin dgra// skad cig mar gcod pa'i gsang chos 'bri// dbyings nam mkhar seng khri pad nyi'i steng*// rje rgyal ba kun yum rnal 'byor mar// mdun yi dam g.yas su sangs rgyas dang*// rgyab dam chos g.yon phyogs dge 'dun tshogs// steng rtsa brgyud bla ma mtha' skor du// skyabs rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams// mdangs 'ja' dang 'od kyi gur khang dbus// byin rlabs kyi gzi byin thibs se bzhugs// bdag mkha' mnyam 'gro kun byang chub bar// dgra 'khor ba'i 'jigs las skyob pa'i phyir// yid khyed shes blo gtad ling bskyur gyis// mgon dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// ma rigs drug srid pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis// bzod dka' bar mnar ba'i sdug bsngal las// bdag kho nas bla med rdzogs byang par// dus myur ba nyid du bsgral bar bya/ phaṭaḥ dpal rdo rje chos dang rnal 'byor mar// rje nā ro ta pa yab sras sogs// skyabs rtsa bar brgyud pa'i bla ma la// yid mos gus drag pos gsol ba 'debs// gnas ri khrod zin cing nges 'byung dang*// byams snying rje byang chub sems mchog 'byongs// don gnas lugs spros bral rang zhal mjal// rten 'di ru grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ phaṭaḥ lus pags pa gser gyi sa gzhir gdal// byang khog gi lhun po dpang mthor brtsegs// yan lag gi gling dang gling phran bkod// rje skyabs yul rnams dgyes pa'i zhing du 'bul/ phaṭaḥ rang sems kyi ngo bo rnal 'byor ma// steng nam mkhar 'thon pas gri gug gis// mgo gcod pa thod pa'i sgyed pur bkal// lus sha rus phung po khrag mtshor bskyil/

phaṭaḥ de rlung me sbyor bas bkol ba'i steng*// 'bru gsum gyis bde gshegs byin rlabs bkug /skyon kun sbyangs ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur// dus nam yang 'dzad pa med par spel/ phaṭaḥ dpal rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje chos// mgon rtsa bar brgyud pa'i bla ma la// lus zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod par 'bul// mchog thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ phaṭaḥ lha rdo rje btsun mo rgyal ba'i yum// rgyud rnam bzhi'i yi dam dkyil 'khor la// lus zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod par 'bul// bdag tshe gcig mkha' spyod 'grub par mdzod/ phaṭaḥ zhing gnas yul dpa' bo ḍā ki'i tshogs// chos skyong ba'i srung ma dam can la// lus zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod par 'bul// rkyen bar chad kun sol mthun rkyen sgrubs/ phaṭaḥ lus bdud rtsi srid zhi'i 'dod yon gyi// nor ma tshang med pas mchod sbyin mgron// kun ji ltar 'dod pa'i 'byor pa yi// lus zag med kyi ngo bor mnyes shing tshim/ phaṭaḥ gdon lan chags rigs drug snying rje'i mgron// kun bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'dis tshims nas// lus lha dang sems nyid chos kyi skur// sangs rgyas nas mkha' spyod gnas su gshegs/ phaṭaḥ slar rang lus thol skyes ling gis 'gyel// 'og sa gzhi'i khyon mnyam pags pa bkram// sha ri bo rus pa'i gram bur gdal// khrag klad zhag nang rol dmar rtsar spung*/ phaṭaḥ khyod snang srid lha 'dre dregs pa'i tshogs// gzugs cir yang bsgyur ba'i 'phrul po che// mthu nus pa'i stobs kyi shugs bskyed de// char drag po'i sprin bzhin gtibs la shog phaṭaḥ ngas gces par phongs pa'i lus ster na// sha rus pa'i phung po chem gyis zo// dmar khrag chen rgya mtsho hub kyis drangs// gos zhing chen g.yang gzhi ling gyis gyon/ phaṭaḥ ster ma nus rnal 'byor snying stobs chung*// za ma nus lha 'dre rtsal re zhan// cho 'phrul gyi rtsal dgu sprug la thong*// til tsam gyi lhag ma med par gyis/

phaṭaḥ sems skye 'gags gnas pa'i tshul med par// dbyings nam mkha' lta bur su yis bsdig /lus sgyu ma 'di nges par 'dor dgos pas// dus da res btang ba tshogs kyi mchog /phaṭaḥ kun dga' mgu rangs nas gdug sems zhi// rgyud byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis brlan// rang so so'i gnas su da song la// gtan bde ba thar pa'i grong du gshegs/ phaṭaḥ mchod bya dang mchod byed kyi 'khor gsum sogs// don rang ngos nas grub pa'i gtad so bral// phyi tha snyad rgyu 'bras mi bslu ba'i// rten 'brel gyi ltad mo mtshar po che/ phaṭaḥ las bsod nams mthu 'dis bdag gzhan 'gro// dus snyigs ma'i tshe 'dir mkha' spyod du// mgon he ru ka dpal yab yum gyi// thugs rdo rje'i klong du grol gyur cig /phaṭaḥ ces rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la brten pa'i zab mo bdud kyi gcod yul 'jug bder spel ba 'di yang rang nyid kyi nyams len dang lhag pa'i lha 'di'i rnal 'byor la brtson pa'i skal mnyam gzhan la'ang phan du re bas snga nas 'bri 'dun thog sde pa chos mdzad skal bzang legs grub tsā ri tra sogs gnas chen bskor bar byon skabs bskul bas mtshams sbyar te/ rgyal khams nyul ba'i bya bral ba 'phags pa dge legs rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas mchog chen por bris pa'o// //sarba dā shū bhaṃ// ༈ /rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i ku sā li'i tshogs bsags dang 'brel bar gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa gcod pa'i man ngag gnad kyi spu gri zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ bde chen ye shes dga' bzhi'i 'dzum dkar gyis// ring nas 'khyud pa'i stong nyid bu mo'i gzugs// rnam kun mchog ldan dbyings kyi yum chen mor// yongs shar rang rig don gyi phag mor 'dud// chos kun sems las gud na ma mchis kyang*// gnyis 'dzin 'khrul par shar ba'i 'dre bo che// re dog dpung bcas gcig char gcod pa'i mtshon// man ngag gnad kyi spu gri 'di na spel// zhes mchod par brjod nas 'dir rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i ku sā li'i tshogs bsags dang 'brel bar gcod kyi gdams pa nyams su blang bder 'god pa la don gsum ste/

dogs pa gcod pa/ gdams pa dngos bshad pa/ mtha' dpyod cung zad smos pa'o// dang po ni/ spyir nā ro mkha' spyod kyi chos skor 'di la/ rje btsun gong ma rnams kyis gcod kyi ming 'dogs mdzad pa'i yi ge med kyang slob bshad kyi khrid 'chad pa'i skabs su zhal shes gsum 'byung ba'i dang po'i nang tshan ku sā li'i tshogs bsags 'di la gcod ces pa'i ming 'dogs dang*/ dmigs pa'i gsal 'debs su phaṭa sbyor ba'i phyag len med pa ma gtogs gdams ngag gi mgo mjug thams cad ma gcig gis gcod yul nas gsung ba'i lus sbyin dang khyad par mi 'dug pas de la dgongs nas/ gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang gi dngos slob 'phags pa dge legs rgyal mtshan gyis gtso bor ku sā li'i tshogs bsags la khog phub cing*/ ma gcig gi gsung las kyang cung zad kha skong nas nā ro mkha' spyod la brten pa'i gcod mkha' 'gro'i snying bcud du grags pa de nyid mdzad pa yin pas/ lugs 'di la gcod kyi ming 'dogs ye nas mi rung ba'i klan ka med do// gnyis pa la thog mar skyabs yul gsal gdab pa ni/ snang stong spros bral ngang las gzhal yas khang*// mtshan nyid kun rdzogs dbus su rin chen khrir// rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje chos// dus gsum rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur// ces brjod cing bsam/ skyabs 'gro ni/ ma rig 'khrul snang lha 'dres gtso byas pa'i// mkha' mnyam 'gro kun deng nas byang chub bar// skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la// snying khong rus pa'i gting nas skyabs su mchi// lan gsum/ sems bskyed ni/ kye ma 'gro kun 'khor bar snyug re ring*// de las skyob phyir bdag gis sku bzhi'i grong*// nyul te 'gro rnams gtan bde'i gnas su 'god// de phyir zab gsang lam 'di nyams len bgyi// lan gsum/ 'khor 'das chos kun stong pa'i rang mdangs las// dwangs ma lnga ldan 'ja' 'od 'khyil pa'i klong*// rin chen las grub bkod legs gzhal yas khang*// stong gsum khyab pa'i gser zhun khri yi steng*// sna tshogs chu skyes zla nyi brtsegs pa'i dbus// drin can bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje chos// dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdor dril 'dzin// rin chen rgyan dang dar gyi na bzas mdzes// dwangs shel ltar gsal rus pa'i rgyan drug 'phyar// bcu drug nyams ldan rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs// skyabs kun 'dus zhal mgon de'i mtha' skor du// brgyud pa'i bla ma dpa' bo ḍā ki'i tshogs// yi dam zhi khro sangs rgyas byang sems dang*// chos skyong nor lha so so'i 'khor dang bcas// dgyes 'dzum brtse bas dgongs bzhin bzhugs pa yi// gnas gsum gsal snang ma 'gags chu zla bzhin// 'bru gsum gyis mtshan thugs srog hūm̐ yig las// 'od zer 'phro 'dus sras bcas rgyal ba kun// spyan drangs gnyis med thim pas lha tshogs rnams// skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur// skyabs mchog rdo rje chos dang rnal 'byor ma// nā ro ta pa rje btsun gong ma lnga// tshar chen yab sras brgyud 'dzin bcas pa sogs// rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bdag 'dzin rtsa ba chod par byin gyis rlobs// gnyis snang 'khrul pa zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// re dog dbyings su thim par byin gyis rlobs// bdud bzhi rtsad nas chod par byin gyis rlobs// bcos min snying rje skye bar byin gyis rlobs// 'dre gdon sems su shar bar byin gyis rlobs// tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs// tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs// pags pa gser gyi sa gzhir bdal ba'i dbus// sgal tshig ri rgyal yan lag gling phran bzhi// 'dren byed zung ni nyi zla'i rang bzhin dang*// phyi nang don snod lha mi'i dpal 'byor tshogs// mi zad nam mkha' mdzod du spros pa 'di// mtshungs med skyabs gnas dam pa'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas 'gro kun sku bzhi'i rgyal srid la// ring min longs su spyod par byin gyis rlobs/

phaṭa/ rang rig skye med rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// a wa dhū ti'i lam nas mkhar 'phags te// phyag g.yas rno ba'i dpal ldan gri gug gis// thod pa bcad de stong gsum khyab par bkod// gzugs phung gri gug 'bar bas rim bzhin gtubs// thod pa'i nang du sha rus ri ltar spungs// dmar chen khrag gi chu rgyun mtsho ltar bskyil// de kun rang byung ye shes me chen gyis// bkol zhing zhu bas ye shes bdud rtsi'i mtsho// 'o ma'i snying po ltar dkar ro brgya ldan// nus mthu phun tshogs mthong thos dran reg gis// bde chen ye shes bskyed pa'i rdzas su gyur/ phaṭa/ rang sems phag mor gsal ba'i thugs ka nas// yid 'phrog mchod pa'i lha mo mdzes sdug can// bandha'i zhal bu thogs pa grangs med 'phros// bdud rtsi'i dga' ston 'gyed la brtson par gyur// zung 'jug sku bzhi'i ngo bo rdo rje 'chang*// bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// bdag lus zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// shlau ka 'di gsum mam bdun brjod/ zab gsang gdams pa gnad 'gag ma 'phyugs par// gcig nas gcig brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma la// bdag lus zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// rjes chags bde chen ye shes dga' bzhi'i ros// gang thugs rnam par myos pa'i yi dam lhar// bdag lus zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhi bsil thugs rje'i ye shes 'dzum dkar gyis// sgrib gnyis mun sel phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la// bdag lus zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul// bla med rdzogs byang thob par byin gyis rlobs// rgyal ba'i gsung gi bdud rtsis rgyud tshim pa'i// byang chub sems dpa' slob mar bcas pa la// bdag lus zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul// bla med rdzogs byang thob par byin gyis rlobs// bstan dang de 'dzin skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i// mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho la// bdag lus zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul// 'gal rkyen zhi zhing chos mthun stong grogs mdzod// 'dzad med 'byor pas 'gro kun skyong mdzad pa'i// gnod sbyin nor lha dpal mgon bdun cu la// bdag lus zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul// 'gal rkyen zhi zhing chos mthun stong grogs mdzod// thog med dus nas 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i 'gro// rigs drug bar do'i sems can thams cad la// bdag lus zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul// so so'i sdug bsngal gtan nas byang gyur cig

/bdag lus zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di// mthong thos dran reg myong kun rgyud tshim zhing*// tshogs rdzogs sgrib sbyang gnas lugs don rtogs nas// zag med bde chen sgyu ma'i lhar gyur cig /phaṭa/ de dag ni ku sā li'i tshogs bsags kyi dgongs pa dngos te/ gzhung gzhan nas bdud rtsi dkar 'gyed du grags pa dang yang don gcig go /de nas gnod cing lan chags pa'i gdon bgegs la bdud rtsi sbyin par gsung ba las 'phros nas zhi ba lhas dmar 'gyed zhig kyang gnang 'dug pas/ de'i tshul la thog mar mgron 'gugs pa ni/ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas snang srid lha 'dre thams cad kyis rna ba blags te nyan par bsam/ yang*/ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas lus sha khrag gi mchod sbyin gyi mgron du shog zer ba'i brdar go nas 'ur thib kyis 'ong bar bsam/ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas thams cad rang gi mtha' skor du nag 'khrig gis 'khod par bsams la/ rang lus skad cig gis che zhing snum par gyur pa de nyid/ rang rig rnal 'byor mas gri gug gis gtub nas lha 'dre rnams kyis lhag med du zos par bsam bzhin pas 'di skad do// bdag lus che zhing snum pa'i tshang bug nas// rang rig phag mo'i skur thon phyag g.yas kyis// gnam lcags gri gug thogs pas bem shun phral// pags pa gser gyi sa gzhir gdal ba'i steng*// sha rus don snying ri ltar spungs pa'i khrod// zhag gi rba rlabs bskyod pa'i khrag mtsho'i 'jing*// rlangs pa'i na bun long long g.yo ba yis// stong gsum 'jig rten ma lus khyab pa 'di// srid gsum yangs pa'i khyon 'dir rgyu byed pa'i// snang srid lha 'dre spyi dang khyad par du// zhe sdang las gyur pho bdud rgyal 'gong dang*// 'dod chags las gyur mo bdud srin mo dang*// gti mug las gyur klu gdon sa bdag gnyan// sum brgya drug cu'i gdon dang glo bur bgegs// stong phrag brgyad cu nad bdag shi gshed sogs// gdug pa'i sems ldan rtsub pa'i cho 'phrul can// sha la rngams shing khrag la dung rnams dang*// thog med dus nas gnyen dang mdza' ba'i grogs// sha khrag srog dbugs nor dang longs spyod kyi// lan chags bu lon snyags pa'i tshogs la 'bul// za bar ma nus lha 'dre rtsal re chung*// ster bar ma phod rnal 'byor snying stobs zhan// mi sdug 'khrul gyi rtsal dgu bsgyur la shog

/dung ba'i tshul du sha rus hab kyis zo// 'thung la rings pas khrag rgyun hub kyis drongs// don snod nang khrol gang la gang 'dod khyer// pags pa zhing chen gos su ling gis gyon// lhag ma til 'bru tsam yang med par zo// tshim zhing mnyes nas gnod pa'i sems zhi ste// sngon gyi lan chags byang zhing bu lon khyer// bcos min byang chub sems kyis rgyud brlan nas// bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog /phaṭa/ snod bcud brtan g.yo'i dngos por bcas rnams dang*// 'khor 'das mgron kun dmigs med dbyings su yal// skye med yum chen dgongs pa mngon gyur nas// gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa ka nas dag gyur cig /phaṭa/ ces brjod/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs dang*/ rang gi sems/ lha 'dre'i sems rnams dbyer med du bsres nas/ sems kyi ngo bo gsal stong zung 'jug tu thag bcad la/ 'dzin med du cham gyis bzhag de la thun mtshams kyi lhar langs la/ dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam yang bya'o// gsum pa ni/ gdams pa 'di nyams su len pa la thog mar dbang gis rgyud smin cing*/ sindhu ra'i byin rlabs dang*/ thun mong ma yin khrid zhal shes dang bcas pa legs par thob cing man ngag gi lung rgyun dang ldan pa zhig nges par dgos la de yang lus sbyin 'di tshogs bsags grangs gtso che bas rgyun du grub na legs la ma grub kyang nam du'ang rung zhing nyams len gyi skabs su glo bur du don med kyi 'jigs skrag drag po sdod mi tshugs pa lta bu 'ong ba dang*/ nub mo rmi lam rtsub mo 'ong ba sogs byung na/ 'jigs snang gis nga rang rmi lam 'di'i ngan lugs kyis 'don rgyu bzhag na legs sam snyam pa byas nas 'phro bcad na/ rang la bar chad sogs kyang 'ong nye bas 'jigs skrag ci byung yang*/ ga re su la skrag don dam par 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang sems kho na'i cho 'phrul las ma 'das shing*/

kun rdzob 'khrul pa'i snang ngor shar ba'i lha 'dre'i tshogs la ni lus sbyin byed pa yin pas 'jigs don med cing*/ za bar 'ong na cis kyang legs pas gang 'dod du zo shig snyam pa'i ngang nas bdag gces 'dzin gyi 'khri ba rbad kyis bcad de/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bzang pos rtsis zin pa'i sgo nas nyams len la 'bad pas 'jigs skrag dang*/ rmi lam ngan pa sogs rang sar zhi bar 'gyur ba ni nges par myong grub yin no// de ltar rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i ku sā li'i tshogs bsags dang 'brel bar gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa gcod pa'i man ngag gnad kyi spu gri zhes bya ba 'di la/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs gzims 'og kun mkhyen chen po/ rig 'dzin grub pa'i gtsug rgyan lce rigs rdo rje 'chang chen po mched gnyis la sogs pa yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i zhal snga nas/ nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs thun mong ma yin pa'i dmigs khrid rnams lan du ma dang*/ zhi ba lhas mdzad pa'i gcod mkha' 'gro'i snying bcud kyi lung sogs thob pa yin na'ang*/ rang nyid skyes sbyangs yon tan gyi dris ma gos par brten 'bri ba'i 'os su mi 'dug kyang*/ yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen slob ma dbu mdzad byams pa mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin gyis lha rdzas/ rin chen gnyis pa'i gnang skyes dang bcas bskul ma gnang ba'i bzhed skong du/ shākya'i dge sbyong byams pa phrin las yon tan gyis sug bris su bgyis pa'o// sarba dā maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
